set.body:
Ledger items G39 (all-events term; explicit main-effect + modulator pairing, today hrf(x, modulators(...)) yields slopes only), G32 (kernel-level unit-peak normalization; normalize = TRUE divides each column by its own max), G1/G34 (FIR and B-spline span), G2 (serial orthogonalization in formula), G3/G20 (product modulators of centred components), G4 (one slope shared across cells), G9/G30 (SPMG3 dispersion vs second derivative; temporal-derivative convention), G14 (derivative-basis orthogonalization).
Acceptance: each item parses, builds and round-trips through SF4; R parity fixtures where fmridesign has an equivalent.

Consumer: PLS Neuro native model studio epic (see the PLS Neuro integration ticket that names this id). General capability; no application-specific branches.
PLS Neuro spec: docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and docs/design/model-studio/ (branch studio/model-authoring-hillclimb, f8d32f0).
set.title: Formula grammar batch A for default models (all-events terms, modulated-term pairing, kernel normalization, FIR/B-spline span, serial orthogonalization, product modulators, shared slopes, derivative conventions)
